title: Write about Doing Favors for People
prompts: 1. How do you feel about doing favors for people?
2. What could you do to help others?
3. Who are you going to help and why?
4. Why would you enjoy doing favors?
model: I feel proud when I do a favor for people. I can hold the door or elevator for someone. Check in on an elderly neighbor or bring dinner to someone who has been facing illness or a tough time. Buy food for a homeless person. I find that lending a hand is really enjoyable and most people I help are grateful.
